security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU does not enforce the SPMP L (lock) bit as mandatory, allowing S-mode writes via siselect to modify locked spmpcfg[i] or spmpaddr[i] entries, or does not require M-mode access (via miselect) to clear the lock bit
security_spec.summary: SPMP L bit is now mandatory (was optional); QEMU must enforce that locked SPMP entries are immutable via S-mode siselect and only clearable by M-mode miselect, otherwise M-mode sandboxing of S-mode is defeated

findings.finding: SPMP (S-mode Physical Memory Protection) is not implemented in this QEMU codebase. No spmpcfg[] CSRs, spmpaddr[] CSRs, SPMP lock-bit handling, SPMP state structures (spmp_table_t), or SPMP VMState migration exist. The siselect/miselect CSRs present are only used for AIA and S*csrind, not for SPMP entry selection. The spec violation condition ('QEMU does not enforce the SPMP L lock bit as mandatory, allowing S-mode writes via siselect to modify locked spmpcfg[i]') cannot be triggered because the entire SPMP subsystem is absent.
findings.snippet: N/A — no SPMP code exists in target/riscv/
